features.title: What We Do
features.paragraph: From the first idea to a stable product in production: we cover the full software development cycle for your business.

development.title: Custom Software Development
development.paragraph: Web, mobile and desktop applications built around your processes: B2B and B2C platforms, customer portals and internal tools that work in all popular browsers and on any device.

architecture.title: Architecture of Complex Systems
architecture.paragraph: We design the structure of your system before writing code, so it stays reliable, secure and ready to scale as your audience and workload grow.

design.title: Interactive Web Design
design.paragraph: Clear, logical interfaces that help users find what they need quickly. Good UX means fewer abandoned visits and more completed orders.

payments.title: Payment System Integration
payments.paragraph: We connect online payment providers to your website or application, so customers can pay quickly, safely and in a familiar way.

ai.title: AI Chatbots
ai.paragraph: A conversational assistant that answers customer questions around the clock and can be trained on information about your business. Try it on our AI page.

support.title: Support and Maintenance
support.paragraph: After launch we keep your product up to date: we fix issues, update dependencies and add new features as your business evolves.

readyToHelp.title: We Are Ready to Help
readyToHelp.paragraph: Tell us about your task, whether it is a new product, an upgrade of an existing system or a single feature. We will suggest a solution, estimate the work and agree on a plan that fits your budget.
readyToHelp.imageAlt: A team discussing a project together

about.title: Why Businesses Choose WONRIAL
about.paragraph: We build software for a specific business task, not from a template. Every project starts with understanding your goals, users and processes, and ends with a product your team can rely on every day.

discovery.title: 1. Discovery and Planning
discovery.paragraph: We study your business, users and goals, agree on the scope and priorities, and propose an architecture and a work plan.

development.title: 2. Design and Development
development.paragraph: We design the interface and build the product in short iterations, showing you results regularly so you can give feedback early.

launch.title: 3. Launch and Support
launch.paragraph: We test and launch the product, monitor how it works and keep improving it based on feedback from real users.

development.title: Software development. Architecture and design of complex systems for your business
development.p1: Custom software development is the process of designing, building, integrating, scaling, and upgrading software solutions to address the pressing needs or achieve objectives of your specific business.
development.p2: We deliver custom web, mobile, and desktop software solutions that broadly fall under 3 main categories – management of B2B, B2C interactions, and internal operations. Our software confidently works across all popular browsers, OSes, and mobile platforms, scales to millions of users and delivers immaculate UX through a clear, logical layout and smooth workflows.

design.title: Design for interactive web applications
design.p1: An interactive web design is a design for websites which uses other inbuilt software, modules or features aimed at creating an environment for a website or web application user to be actively engaged during visit or use as the case may be, thereby improving his or her user experience (UX).
design.p2: Having prior knowledge of your expected users’ profile and their presumed preferences enables the web design’s interactivity to accommodate them. For example, users that do not want to spend much time on your site should not be made to do so. Rather make it simpler for them to get the much-needed information as fast as possible. Such users abandon transactions or site visits when they don’t achieve their aims in a shorter time.

payments.title: Integration of electronic payment systems
payments.p1: Consumers want convenience; it’s one of the reasons that online shopping continues to grow in popularity. A study by BigCommerce found that eCommerce is increasing 23 percent year over year. Moreover, Millennials and Gen Xers — two generations who make up the majority of the U.S. population — spend six hours per week shopping online.
